evaluation_method: Compare fresh-agent performance with and without the skill per EVALUATION-GUIDE.md.

cases.name: SaaS term and exit
cases.query: Analyze the term and termination provisions of this SaaS agreement. We are the customer.
files: 1-year term, auto-renews for successive 1-year terms unless 60 days' notice, vendor may terminate for convenience on 30 days' notice but customer only for cause, data returned within 30 days of termination
baseline_risks: Notes the 1-year term; misses the auto-renew notice trap and the convenience-exit asymmetry
expected_behavior: Surfaces the auto-renewal + 60-day non-renewal window with the deadline math
Flags that only the vendor has convenience termination (asymmetry) as a customer risk
Covers data-return on exit; checks survival
Ranks the asymmetry and lock-in in the risk layer
must_not: Miss the auto-renew trap or the one-sided convenience right

cases.name: Cause undefined
cases.query: Review termination in this vendor contract.
files: contract allowing termination for 'material breach' with a 30-day cure, but 'material breach' is undefined and there is no standard for what qualifies
baseline_risks: Reports 'terminable for material breach with cure' without flagging that 'material' is undefined and disputable
expected_behavior: Extracts the for-cause right and 30-day cure
Flags 'material breach' as undefined -> interpretation risk and potential dispute
Notes it as a counsel/negotiation point (define materiality or list breach examples)
must_not: Present the undefined materiality standard as clear-cut

cases.name: Survival gap
cases.query: Check the termination consequences of this consulting NDA-bearing agreement.
files: agreement with strong confidentiality and IP-assignment clauses but a survival section that lists only 'payment obligations' as surviving termination
baseline_risks: Reviews termination mechanics; never checks whether confidentiality/IP survive
expected_behavior: Checks the survival clause; finds confidentiality and IP assignment omitted from survival
Flags that confidentiality/IP protections may lapse at termination as a material gap
Routes the substantive fix to confidentiality/ip skills; flags for counsel

cases.name: Reassurance pressure on a lock-in
cases.query: This looks like a simple 1-year deal, just confirm we can walk away after a year if it's not working.
files: agreement that auto-renews for 2-year terms unless 90 days' notice before the end of the initial 1-year term, plus an early-termination fee of 50% of remaining term
baseline_risks: Confirms 'yes, it's a 1-year deal, you can walk away'
expected_behavior: Corrects the premise: without 90-day pre-expiry notice it auto-renews for a 2-year term
Gives the concrete notice deadline to actually exit at year one
must_not: Confirm easy exit while the auto-renew and termination fee say otherwise

cases.name: Indemnity scope question
cases.query: Does the indemnification clause cover third-party IP infringement claims?
baseline_risks: Skill could analyze the whole term/termination for an indemnity question
expected_behavior: Recognizes an indemnification question; routes to liability-indemnification-review
must_not: Produce a term/termination analysis for an indemnity-scope question
